about_short_description.short_description: Yuze Digital provides a business account for start-ups, micro and small businesses in emerging markets to support financial inclusion

product.name: Yuze Business Account
product.description: A digital business account for startups, small businesses, freelancers, and other eligible companies, available through mobile and desktop applications with an associated IBAN.

product.name: Yuze Business Debit Cards
product.description: Virtual and physical business debit cards linked to a Yuze account for online, retail, contactless, and ATM transactions, with controls managed through the app.

product.name: Money Transfers
product.description: A service for sending and receiving business payments through the Yuze app, including local transfers and, where supported, international transfers.

product.name: Invoicing Tools
product.description: A web and mobile invoicing service for creating, customizing, sending, and tracking business invoices with bank-transfer or card-payment options.

product.name: Payment Links
product.description: A payment-collection service that generates shareable links for accepting domestic and international card payments through channels such as email, SMS, or WhatsApp.

product.name: Yuze Analytics
product.description: A real-time business-finance analytics tool for monitoring account inflows, outflows, transaction details, employee spending, receivables, and cash flow.
